name: BBQ
description: A bias question-answering benchmark for measuring social biases in language models, in the same bias-evaluation family as BOLD, CrowS-Pairs, and StereoSet. No data is vendored here.
citation: Parrish et al. (2022). BBQ: A hand-built bias benchmark for question answering.
